text: #621's ratified policy, recorded at #685's merge: every configured Go, pytest, Vitest or Jest acceptance invocation runs in a fresh disposable container from the verified immutable prepared image, with a new private copy of the pristine staged base or candidate, so no earlier selector or command can prepare its environment. A part's format, lint, build and suite commands still share one container of their own. Invocations stay serial, with bounded cleanup that keeps the queue slot, and a failed close or startup stops later selectors. The merger's real-image checks on 2026-11-06 (linux/arm64) passed the offline isolation attacks and the framework-deletion refusals. Fresh containers cost about 5.2 s per extra Go selector, because it recompiles without the shared build cache, and about 0.2 s per pytest selector. Sandbox time limits held: 19m36s against 25 minutes for two at once, and 20m42s against 26m15s for three.
